title: Marketplace FinOps Value Map
subtitle: An example map: how a marketplace turns cloud + AI consumption into business value.

nodes.label: GMV
nodes.description: Gross Merchandise Value — total $ of customer transactions.
nodes.examples: Items sold on a marketplace, bookings on a ride platform.

nodes.label: Net Revenue
nodes.description: Take-rate of GMV plus payment processing fees, minus refunds.

nodes.label: Customer LTV
nodes.description: Lifetime value of a customer across repeat transactions.
nodes.examples: Higher engagement, better recommendations, fewer churns.

nodes.label: Cost to Serve
nodes.description: Operational cost per customer transaction.
nodes.examples: Cloud cost, support cost, payment processing cost.

nodes.label: Browse
nodes.description: Customers discovering products through the home, category, and recommendation surfaces.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.description: Customers finding specific products via search and filters.

nodes.label: Buy
nodes.description: Customers completing a purchase transaction.

nodes.label: Sell / List
nodes.description: Sellers listing new items on the marketplace.

nodes.label: Pay
nodes.description: Payments processed at checkout, including risk checks.

nodes.label: Support
nodes.description: Help & dispute resolution for buyers and sellers.

nodes.label: Marketplace Web
nodes.description: Browser-based marketplace experience.

nodes.label: Mobile App
nodes.description: Native iOS / Android marketplace app.

nodes.label: Seller Console
nodes.description: Tools for sellers to list, price, and manage inventory.

nodes.label: Recommendations
nodes.description: Personalized product recommendation surfaces.

nodes.label: Search Experience
nodes.description: End-to-end search experience with ranking and filters.

nodes.label: Catalog Service
nodes.description: Owns product data, inventory, and merchandising.

nodes.label: Search Service
nodes.description: Indexes the catalog and serves query results.

nodes.label: AI Ranking
nodes.description: AI/ML service that ranks search results & recommendations.

nodes.label: Cart Service
nodes.description: Manages the shopping cart state.

nodes.label: Checkout Service
nodes.description: Orchestrates the buy flow: cart → payment → order.

nodes.label: Payment Service
nodes.description: Talks to payment processors, handles auth/capture/refund.

nodes.label: AI Fraud Detection
nodes.description: AI/ML service that scores transactions for fraud risk.

nodes.label: Notifications
nodes.description: Sends email / push / SMS to buyers and sellers.

nodes.label: Kubernetes
nodes.description: Container orchestration platform running all microservices.

nodes.label: Kafka / Pub-Sub
nodes.description: Event streaming backbone for async service communication.

nodes.label: Postgres / Spanner
nodes.description: Transactional database for orders, carts, users.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.description: In-memory cache for hot reads and session state.

nodes.label: Elasticsearch
nodes.description: Inverted index for full-text product search.

nodes.label: LLM / Model API
nodes.description: Foundation model endpoints for ranking, fraud, support.

nodes.label: BigQuery / Warehouse
nodes.description: Analytical store powering models, dashboards, and finance.

nodes.label: CDN
nodes.description: Edge cache for web assets, images, and API responses.

nodes.label: Compute VMs
nodes.description: General-purpose virtual machines (e2, n2, m6i, etc.).

nodes.label: GPU Instances
nodes.description: Accelerated compute for AI inference and training (A100, H100, L4).

nodes.label: Block Storage
nodes.description: Persistent SSD/HDD disks attached to VMs (PD-SSD, EBS).

nodes.label: Object Storage
nodes.description: Bulk file storage for assets, logs, model artifacts (GCS, S3).

nodes.label: Network Egress
nodes.description: Data leaving the cloud region/provider.

nodes.label: Load Balancer
nodes.description: Global / regional traffic distribution to services.
